name: india-esz-dashboard
description: Weekly mirror and structured dataset of MoEFCC Eco-Sensitive Zone notifications, enriched with Wikidata protected area data

scripts.suggest:missing-state: node scripts/plugins/quickstatements-from-wikilinks.js --input data/wikidata-protected-areas.csv --output data/wikidata-protected-areas.state-suggestions.csv --qs-output data/wikidata-protected-areas.state.qs.txt --property P131 --property-label state --target-types Q12443800,Q467745 --filter-column state
scripts.suggest:missing-located-in: node scripts/plugins/quickstatements-from-wikilinks.js --input data/wikidata-protected-areas.csv --output data/wikidata-protected-areas.locatedInAdminTerritorialEntity-suggestions.csv --qs-output data/wikidata-protected-areas.locatedInAdminTerritorialEntity.qs.txt --property P131 --property-label locatedInAdminTerritorialEntity --target-types Q105626471,Q1149652,Q467745,Q12443800 --filter-column locatedInAdminTerritorialEntity
scripts.update: npm run fetch && npm run parse && npm run clean && npm run enrich:wikidata && npm run enrich:archive && npm run enrich:allmaps && npm run build:geojson && npm run build:full-join && npm run build:atlas
